recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if CQI makes a new final decision to copy more Quality Measure IG content or profiles into core; otherwise adding profile-specific CQF content would exceed the current FHIR-24628 scope.
issue_request: FHIR-24628 is an Applied CQI change request, resolved Persuasive for R6, asking to update the FHIR core proportion Measure example using the latest example from the Quality Measure IG. The updated resolution explicitly excludes moving the ProportionMeasure profile into base FHIR.
initial_application: Git commit 8aec32f4e56ea8de25d506080dd4d7042e5a7e4a added source/measure/measure-BCSComponent.xml and wired it into source/measure/list-Measure-examples.xml; HL7/fhir#3900 merged that work. Commit 2d0d4b5fcf3fb35e91458508879c829933e9f665 then moved improvementNotation onto Measure.group for the BCS example. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-24628 was on the combined branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists measure=Measure, so the Measure examples and example list are in current build scope. The Quality Measure IG source contains BCSComponent with CQF proportion profile metadata, while the core adaptation keeps the proportion-scored BCSComponent example and does not add the excluded ProportionMeasure/CQF proportion profile to core. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the updated disposition: the BCSComponent proportion example is present, listed, and later cleaned up for the current Measure model without moving the proportion profile into base FHIR.
